title: Pressing the button in 15 minutes! It is finally time!
author: BSwayzeYo
selftext:
It's been a long time coming and a lot of sharing and helping each other through the muck and the haters. I'm finally clicking the button and I have 3 more in the pipeline! [WinsomeRealms.com](http://WinsomeRealms.com) and Fishing Nooks: Beaver's Pond launch TODAY!

Press on fellow AI-Devs! 🎣👏😆

comments.author: aigamedev-mod
comments.body: u/BSwayzeYo could you add more about how AI fit into your development process? Just mentioning that AI was used doesn't cut it. Under Rule 4, promotional posts need to contribute something by discussing how the game was actually made. Otherwise the sub gets buried in ads. If there's no update, this post may be removed.

replies.author: BSwayzeYo
replies.body: Sorry for the lack of processes in the post. I’m pretty focused on the timing to release. I will update post-haste. Thanks for not instant-removing.

comments.author: Gigaslavx
comments.body: I understand making games for fun or to learn something new but I never understood this not sure how to call delusion. The game is not bad excuse the pun but it's nothing special it will draw amongst other ai generated games. It's like having a mediocre child and loving them so much not realizing they're yes a living human but there's nothing special

comments.author: Right-Disaster2141
comments.body:
Hey, it's actually pretty cool, good luck!

Consider publishing it on [gameplaydex](http://gameplaydex.com) for a bit of free marketing!

comments.author: CodeGuyJay
comments.body: Word of advice, saying you have three more games in the pipeline during your launch announcement makes people take you less seriously, for good reason lol. Good luck!

comments.author: drahgon
comments.body: Good luck but there’s another guy who made a fishing game that looks about 100 X better.

comments.author: Good-Acanthaceae-136
comments.body:
If you want some feedback on why people are going to call this slop it's because of this:

1. It has a mish mash of styles that don't fit together.

2. The graphics are sloppy and look like AI, scales of things seem off, reflections don;t look how flections should look in some scenes, the isometric perspective looks off as some things are on a 2d perspective and some on 3D. The fish images look lower res compared to everything else.

3. The UI looks like generic AI.

4. The fishing mechanic is really generic and the animations are lackluster.

comments.author: Marod_
comments.body: Oh hey, I had it wishlisted and will grab it. I have been writing my own fishing game for awhile when I came across it. I remember loving super black bass when I was a kid and had an appetite for something between arcade and realism. Good luck to you.
